items.description: 4.1.4 ดวงโคมไฟฟ้าและอุปกรณ์
- โคมไฟติดลอยแบบกล่องเหล็ก (BATTEN LUMINAIRE) หลอด LED TUBE T8, ขนาดไม่เกิน 1-10W ชนิดให้แสง COOL WHITE ความสว่างไม่ต่ำกว่า 1,600 ลูเมน อายุการใช้งาน ไม่น้อยกว่า 25,000 ชั่วโมง
items.note: *** The BOQ says 'ไม่เกิน 1-10W' where EE-01's legend says 'ไม่เกิน 1-20 วัตต์'. Everything else in the description (COOL WHITE, 1,600 lm, 25,000 h) matches EE-01 word for word. One of the two is a typo. ***

warnings: *** EXTRACTION METHOD FOR THIS SHEET -- READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING IT. *** The two BOQ sets in this book (ฐานรากแผ่ at PNG 71-87 and ฐานรากเข็มตอก at PNG 88-104) are the SAME 34-sheet ปร.4 template issued twice, differing only in (a) the foundation name in the title line and (b) the foundation item inside หมวดงานโครงสร้าง. The page mapping is exact and one-to-one: set-2 PNG = set-1 PNG + 17, same physical half, same แผ่นที่ n/34. That mapping and the line-for-line identity of the non-structural categories were VERIFIED VISUALLY at ten points spanning the whole range: 88_1 (1/34), 88_2 (2/34), 89_1 (3/34), 89_2 (4/34), 90_1 (5/34), 90_2 (6/34), 91_1 (7/34), 95_2 (16/34), 99_1 (23/34), 104_2 (34/34). This particular sheet's rows were NOT re-read from its own PNG; they were carried across from the verified-identical ฐานรากแผ่ counterpart named in derived_from. Anyone using this file for anything quantity-critical should re-read its own PNG first.

PNG contains TWO portrait BOQ sheets laid out side by side in one landscape scan, per spec §11. Rotate the PNG 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. The physical RIGHT half is the LOWER-numbered sheet and is written to _1.json; the physical LEFT half is _2.json.

EVERY PRICE COLUMN IS BLANK ON EVERY ROW OF THE WHOLE BOQ -- ราคาหน่วยละ, จำนวนเงิน (material and labour), and รวมค่าวัสดุและค่าแรงงาน. This is a แบบ ปร.4 QUANTITY schedule issued unpriced by กองมาตรฐานราคากลาง for the estimator to fill in. Nulls are transcribed, never invented.

The title block is identical on every sheet of the set: form แบบ ปร.4, drawing numbers S-62047 / AR-61142 / SN-62034 / EE-62062 / M-62028, สถานที่ก่อสร้าง ทั่วไป, unit บาท, with ประมาณการโดย and ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ left blank.

*** THIS IS THE LUMINAIRE SCHEDULE THE ELECTRICAL DRAWINGS NEVER PROVIDE: 7 batten fittings, 33 downlights and 8 wall lights, 48 luminaires in all. *** EE-03 and EE-04 draw the positions but carry no schedule, so the counts on those two files were read off the symbols and flagged count_read_from_symbols. These are the authoritative numbers.

The luminaire descriptions are copied from EE-01's legend almost verbatim, including the performance minima -- 1,600 lm and 25,000 h for the battens, 600 lm for the E27 lamps, COOL WHITE against WARM WHITE.

*** ONE FIGURE DISAGREES: the BOQ says the batten lamp is 'ไม่เกิน 1-10W' where EE-01 says 'ไม่เกิน 1-20 วัตต์'. *** A 1,600 lm LED T8 is more consistent with 20 W than 10 W, so EE-01 is the likelier correct value -- but neither is corrected. Both are recorded as printed and flagged.

*** THE CABLE QUANTITIES ARE THE LARGEST NUMBERS IN THE ELECTRICAL BOQ: 1,396 m of IEC01 2.5 sq.mm. *** Against 423 m of ø15 conduit that is about 3.3 conductors per conduit metre -- consistent with EE-01's '2-2.5, G-2.5' (two cores plus earth) in every circuit.

48 m of NYY 10 sq.mm against EE-02's 'ประมาณ 20 เมตร' service run: the run is TWO-CORE ('2-1/C-10 NYY'), so 2 x 20 m = 40 m plus terminations gives 48 m. The two figures are consistent once the core count is applied -- a good cross-check.
IEC01 10 sq.mm at 2 m is the earth conductor from the board to the rod, matching EE-02's '1-10 IEC 01 in ø15 มม. PVC'.
'BLUB' for 'BULB' is printed on the downlight line; transcribed as printed.
